messages:
opsbot: [Incident] Paging: penumbra-prod-pool high 5xx rate, latency spike on VPC tenant penumbra-inc. Severity: S2. Link: https://redwood/inc/2765432100

devon: acknowledged, I'm oncall. oncall handoff starting.

maria: i'm jumping in — are we seeing OOMs or network drops?

samir: looking at node metrics now, one worker (gpu-03) showing steady memory growth, GC-like spikes then stalled tokens.

lisa: customer-report: Penumbra sent message, some API requests time out at ~2s then 504. They flagged inference jobs failing intermittently.

devon: ok isolate: mark penumbra pool read-only, route new traffic to penumbra-fallback (quantized). Can someone throttle large streaming sessions?

maria: doing now: set pool to drain.

megan-cs: copying Penumbra account execs: @penumbra-ops. Will craft customer-safe comm after we stabilize.

samir: quick mitigation runbook applied: evict runaway sessions on gpu-03, restart worker process, enable kernel-fallback. Commands:
```
# evict sessions
redwoodctl pool evict --pool penumbra-prod-pool --node gpu-03
# restart worker
redwoodctl node restart gpu-03
# enable fallback
redwoodctl config set runtime.kernel_fallback=true --pool penumbra-prod-pool
```

maria: restart completed, memory growth stopped. latency returning to baseline for most requests. monitoring for 10m.

devon: thanks. still seeing a handful of 502s from legacy model shard; routing to quantized fallback for 2m burst.

lisa: Penumbra CS updated: they saw degradation for approx 21 minutes. They want an initial timeline + mitigation summary.

megan-cs: draft to Penumbra: "We experienced a transient degradation impacting your VPC pool penumbra-prod-pool between 2026-03-14T20:12Z and 2026-03-14T20:33Z. Root cause investigation is ongoing; initial mitigation included session eviction and worker restart. Full RCA to follow." Thoughts?

maria: looks good. add that we proactively routed to quantized fallback to keep requests live and we are offering a follow-up exec call.

nirmal: root cause preliminary: memory leak in continuous-batching path for model gpt-xx-large when unusual tokenization pattern triggered extra KV retention. Patch ready (runtime PR #4126) to free KV windows correctly.

devon: timeline note: incident created 2765432100 (20:12Z), mitigation started 20:15Z, full worker restart 20:18Z, service normal 20:33Z. Please include timestamps in comms.

megan-cs: updated message and sent to Penumbra SREs. they asked for credit estimate. Any suggestion?

exec-ops: recommend we offer a one-time invoice credit equal to 8% of affected window for hosted usage or 10% of monthly dedicated fee pro-rated, and an executive review offer. legal ok?

lisa: legal greenlit standard credit. CS to finalize with Penumbra.

samir: confirming patch prevents leak in local staging. will schedule hotfix rollout tonight to other dedicated pools; non-blocking but prioritized.

maria: RCA draft for internal review:
- symptom: elevated 5xx and timeouts on penumbra-prod-pool
- root cause: memory retention bug in continuous-batching -> KV cache not releasing under specific token patterns
- immediate mitigation: session eviction, worker restart, kernel fallback
- permanent fix: runtime PR #4126 to free KV windows + additional unit tests, canary rollout planned
- impact: Penumbra experienced ~21 minutes of degraded service, some requests returned 504/502
- customer remediation: one-time credit + exec call offer

devon: small edits: add metrics snapshot filenames and link to logs: https://logs.redwood/penumbra/2765432100

megan-cs: sending internal RCA draft to @exec-ops and @maria for signoff, then will share sanitized version with customer.

exec-ops: signed off on draft. please include the planned canary timeline: hotfix deploy 03/15 02:00Z, monitor 2h, full rollout 03/15 06:00Z.

nirmal: assigning follow-ups: @samir implement tests, @maria own canary, @devon update runbooks to include eviction command. I'll open JIRA INF-1298 for the postmortem.

megan-cs: Penumbra acknowledged initial comms, accepted credit offer in principle, asked for exec call next week. Scheduling.

lisa: closing note: no other customers impacted, dedicated-only pool isolation worked as intended. Good catch on kernel fallback.

devon: thanks all — I'll mark incident resolved in pager after attachments uploaded.

opsbot: Incident 2765432100 status changed -> RESOLVED by devon. Duration: 21m. Severity S2. Tags: vpc, dedicated, penumbra-inc

megan-cs: will send final customer comms (sanitized RCA) by EOD and confirm credit paperwork.

maria: follow-up items: post-incident test coverage, automation for faster eviction, and add metrics alert for memory growth slope. putting on next sprint.

nirmal: thx team. add retrospective notes to INF-1298 and link this thread.

devon: :thumbsup:
